answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the karst of free entry disappears, the shale of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the pearl case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
